235:         let candidate = Candidate::new(&path);
236:         let candidate_filename = path.as_ref().file_name().map(Candidate::new);

238:         for (ref glob, ref syntax) in self.mappings.iter().rev() {

241:                     options.match_file_name && glob.is_match_candidate(filename)

245:             }
246:         }

248:         let file_name = path.as_ref().file_name()?;
249:         self.ignored_suffixes
250:             .try_with_stripped_suffix(file_name, |stripped_file_name| {
251:                 Ok(self.get_syntax_for(stripped_file_name))
